page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 162 at left. Below it, a narrow left margin column of marginal notes, and a main text column on the right. Text runs top to bottom; a catchword-like fragment "stiosuli" sits at the foot right of the text block.

main_text.p: (quod Vigilantio Hieronymus) & per partes ac frusta dilacerandam : Idemque Dominico praestitit (pari blasphemia) pius Archiepiscopus Antoninus : Nihil hic (quantum video) defit praeter aeternum illud Fraterculorum Euangelium : parum vero abfuit (si credimus historijs) quin obtinuisset :

p.i: O quàm perfatuæ sunt tibi, Roma, togæ?

main_text.p: Alij Litanias, Psalterię, & quicquid ad Dei gloriam spiritus accommodauit, ad sanctæ Virginis nomen, ore sacrilego traduxerunt. Et vtinam profecto ista priuata foret super-Hier. aduersf. Vigilant.Henr. Steph. Apol. Herod. & Fox Martyr. Martial.

page.notes: Marginal notes at left: "Hier. aduersf. Vigilant." and "Henr. Steph. Apol. Herod. & Fox Martyr. Martial." Right-column text is italic in the verse line. Catchword "stiosuli" is the continuation of "superstiosuli" split across the foot. Some words in the body are faint; the sentence "Nihil hic" and "si credimus" are read with reasonable confidence.
